# 5-agent randomized ideation sweep (2026-07-17)

5 independent opus agents, one lens each, ~8-12 ideas per agent, ≥4/agent
required to be non-published. Full texts in the session transcript; this
is the complete triaged index. Verdicts: INBOX (shortlisted into
IDEAS.md), FAMILY (folds into an existing family's future decisions),
DEAD (tombstone/closure collision or self-flagged), ARCHIVE (real idea,
not competitive now — revisit on a state change).

## Convergence signal

**buyback-blackout** was independently generated by 3 of 5 agents
(forced-flow, ecology, behavioral): the 10b-18 repurchase bid — the
largest structural price-insensitive buyer, biggest in mega-caps by
$/ADV — goes dark for ~4-5 weeks pre-earnings; removing a bid is not
arbitrageable by liquidity provision (replacing it means taking the
directional risk). XBRL repurchase $ + earnings calendar + ADV, all in
hand or free; no published cross-section (desk notes only). → INBOX,
highest-priority new entry.

## Tally

57 generated → 16 INBOX (clustered to 12 IDEAS.md lines), 9 FAMILY
(routed to existing family menus), 12 ARCHIVE, 12 DEAD (3 by ledger
dedup — C25/C23 collisions and a self-flagged large-cap death — the
rest by OI/PIT/breadth disqualifiers or self-flags). Dedup against
FACTORS.md tombstones caught 2 would-be repeat looks before they cost
anything.
